name: gp
description: Manage all your work in GitHub Projects (v2) with git and the gh CLI — boards, columns (kanban), fields, views, issues (create/edit/move/close/delete), image attachments, TODO checklists, drafts, assignees and collaborators. scripts/gp.py looks up IDs by name and reads every change back. In Claude Code cloud sessions (GraphQL and the board are blocked) it uses REST gh api calls and queues board moves as gp:… labels for the gp-sync Action.
